name: Team Squirtle: Torrential Surge & Frozen Tempest
archetype: 4x Electric and 4x Ice precision OHKOs, Intimidate physical blunting, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Clair's 5v5 dragon duel prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon from the party: Jolteon/Sandslash leads with scorching speed to eliminate Feraligatr/Gyarados with an instant 4x super-effective STAB Discharge; Lapras rotates into the duel core to wall incoming attacks and fire devastating 4x STAB Ice Beams to delete Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl; Blastoise/Fearow levels to Cap 68 to command the frontline, dousing fire hybrids with heavy STAB Hydro Pump artillery; Arbok/Primeape applies Intimidate to blunt Garchomp/Aerodactyl's Attack on entry and shatters Glaceon/Kingdra with STAB Close Combat; and Alakazam/Weezing utilizes Levitate to ignore Magnitude while executing Ariados/Charizard with STAB Psychic.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 68. STAB Hydro Pump douses opposing fire and rock threats, while Drill Peck cleans up weakened dragons.
486 BST speed sweeper. High-speed Discharge delivers an effortless 4x super-effective OHKO against lead Feraligatr/Gyarados.

roster.status: Active in Party (Rotated into Duel Core)
roster.progression_notes: 535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 67. STAB Ice Beam lands catastrophic 4x super-effective blows to vaporize Donphan/Dragonair and ace Garchomp/Aerodactyl.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Weakens physical dragons on entry, while STAB Close Combat crushes Glaceon/Kingdra.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Magnitude via Levitate. STAB Psychic cleanly executes Ariados/Charizard.

roster.status: Active in Party (Benched for Gym Duel)
roster.progression_notes: Colossal 160 HP tank. Benched during the 5v5 duel in favor of 4x offensive counter-picks, but serves as route travel sponge.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin hazard removal for tactical versatility.
